newsitem.title: USA: Hughes to form joint satellite firm - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Hughes to form joint satellite firm - WSJ.

text.p: Hughes Electronics Corp could announce Thursday plans to combine its satellite system with PanAmSat Corp's satellite network into a global distributor of video, voice and data services as part of Hughes' expected $3-billion acquisition of PanAmSat, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.

Hughes would hold about a 70 percent stake in the new company, the formation of which would give about $30 a share in cash and stock to PanAmSat shareholders, the Journal reported, citing anonymous sources.
